decision.frozen_three_colony_fallback_remains: prior-year banded-breeder chick-presence index under ROSS_ISLAND_BANDED_BREEDER_PERFORMANCE_V1

interpretation: The pinned MAPPPD snapshot cannot supply a source-unambiguous annual chick-count state for all three Ross mark-resight colonies during the predeclared 1996-2012 prior-performance window. Component sites have no qualifying chick-count records, and the parent-site route is structurally incomplete because Cape Bird has no parent site in MAPPPD. Therefore external chick counts cannot replace the frozen banded-breeder performance fallback without shrinking the problem post hoc.
claim_boundary: This is a coverage failure, not evidence that chick abundance is biologically irrelevant.
No chick-count magnitudes or individual movement outcomes were inspected in making this decision.
Do not switch to a Royds-Crozier two-colony model as a rescue.
Do not use MAPPPD chick counts to redefine the primary Ross performance predictor.
